title: DocumentEvidence v1 neutral TypeScript conformance client
preconditions: XML_Compare_Utilities DocumentEvidence OpenAPI 1.4.1 merged to main at 6eeefae925528079d59acd86a2d98975c60f94ce
No fitz imports may be added outside backend/pdf_engine/
change: Add pure TypeScript DocumentEvidence.v1 transport/domain types with the XML_Compare_Utilities contract commit pinned as external schema authority.
Add RFC 8785 JCS canonicalization plus schema-domain SHA-256 helpers for cross-repo conformance vectors.
Add fail-closed response guards for source identity, provider profile, observations, evidence decisions, table discovery and explicit-page table extraction.
Add a thin fetch-based XML_Compare_Utilities client for /v2/tables/discover and /v2/tables/extract; extraction requires sourceHash and explicit 1-based pages.
Add focused Vitest coverage proving JCS/hash compatibility, extraction authority remains evidence-only, invalid source/page/evidence shapes fail closed, and no engineering authority is inferred.
exit: cd frontend && pnpm exec vitest run src/core/document-evidence src/adapters/document-evidence  -> exit 0
cd frontend && pnpm run typecheck  -> exit 0
grep -rn "import fitz" backend/app backend/services backend/tasks  -> empty
forbidden: Do NOT copy XML_Compare_Utilities Python runtime or make Pdf-Hub the canonical schema authority.
Do NOT add vibration/T3/T2.8/T2.9/T4 engineering rules or engineering authority.
Do NOT import fitz outside backend/pdf_engine/ or couple frontend core types to PDF.js/Tesseract/Konva types.
Do NOT relax existing OCR, lint, type or guard gates.
escalate: The XML_Compare_Utilities v1 contract cannot be represented without changing an existing Pdf-Hub architectural invariant.
Implementation needs files outside the declared mayTouch patterns.
Canonicalization differs from the XML_Compare_Utilities RFC 8785 conformance vectors.
